funds.name: General Fund
funds.description: Primary operating fund for the City, covering most departmental expenditures

funds.name: Reserve Fund
funds.description: Unappropriated balance carried between fiscal years; used as a fiscal cushion

funds.name: Stop the Violence Fund
funds.description: Special fund established under City Code Chapter 237 for violence prevention programs

funds.name: American Rescue Plan Trust Fund
funds.description: Federal COVID-19 relief funds; must be obligated by Dec 31, 2024 and spent by Dec 31, 2026

funds.name: Special Food Service Trust Fund
funds.description: Trust fund for food service operations

funds.name: Three Taxing Bodies Trust Fund
funds.description: Trust fund shared across three taxing bodies

funds.name: Early Childhood Community Facilities Fund
funds.description: Fund for early childhood community facility investments, funded by reserve transfers

funds.name: Housing Opportunity Fund
funds.description: Dedicated fund for affordable housing programs, receiving $10M annual transfers

funds.name: Technology Modernization Fund
funds.description: Fund for IT and technology modernization initiatives
